name: Timeparadox
source:
After his girlfriend Aiko is mysteriously killed, the hero hops in a time machine invented by his uncle and goes on a journey through time to save her.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女友爱子离奇遇害后，主人公登上叔父发明的时间机器，踏上穿越时空的旅程，试图救她一命。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
